entries.he: כְּשֶׁאָדָם מַחֲלִיק וְנוֹפֵל, זֶה עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁהִתְחַזֵּק לַעֲבֹר עֲבֵרָה.
entries.en: 7. When a man slips and falls, this is because he had strengthened himself to commit a sin.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁהוֹלֵךְ וְנוֹפֵל, יֵדַע שֶׁמַּלְאָכָיו הַשּׁוֹמְרִים אוֹתוֹ נִסְתַּלְּקוּ.
entries.en: 1. One who who is going (walking) and falls, should know that his guardian angels have deserted him.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Falling, Part 2, item 1

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Falling, Part 2, item 1
